acquisition method: The digest was analyzed using the data-dependent multitask capability of the instrument
alkylation reagent: alkylated with iodoacetamide prior to the in-gel digestion
cleavage agent: adding 5 μl of 10 ng/μl trypsin in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate
enrichment method: performed MS analysis on immunoprecipitated βIV-spectrin derived from COS-7 cell lysates
fractionation method: The protein samples were fractionated on an SDS-PAGE and submitted for analysis
fragmentation method: The data were analyzed by using all collision-induced dissociation spectra collected in the experiment
instrument: interfacing with a ThermoScientific Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer system
ionization type: The microelectrospray ion source is operated at 2.5 kV
labeling: the peak areas of these chromatograms were used to determine the extent of phosphorylation
reduction reagent: The bands were then reduced with DTT
